angaben: Platform: Android. Languages: German, Turkish, English, Spanish, Bosnian, Croatian, Serbian, Romanian, Portuguese, French, Indonesian, and Hindi, switchable within the app.

Features: Card of the Day, Yes or No, Three Cards, and a Love spread with 78 tarot cards; read coffee grounds yourself with 80 symbols and the cup map; Dictionary, History with your own notes, Share as image, reminder for the Card of the Day.

Dream interpretation: how the dream felt, an area of life, and up to five of 124 dream symbols make up a reading with the whole picture, the meaning of each symbol in its tradition, and a piece of advice; one dream every two days.

Moon calendar on the Home screen: today’s moon phase with the percentage illuminated, the phases of the next six days, the next new moon and full moon, and a short, calm text about the phase; calculated on the phone, without location, without zodiac signs, and without predictions.
The app works without internet and without an account. It stores history and notes on the phone.
Each reading has its rhythm: Card of the Day and Yes or No daily, Three Cards and the full coffee grounds reading every three days, Love once a week. The Dictionary and History are always open.
For entertainment: the readings follow old traditions and are neither a prediction nor advice.
Tarot Cup is available only for Android. A version for iPhone is not planned.
